mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.message_type, m.title, m.content, m.is_read AS `read`, m.create_time, COALESCE(sender_user.username, '\u7cfb\u7edf') AS sender_name, m.related_house_id, h.title AS related_house_title FROM message m LEFT JOIN user_profile sender ON sender.id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN auth_user sender_user ON sender_user.id = sender.user_id LEFT JOIN house h ON h.id = m.related_house_id WHERE ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (recipient_id, sender_id, message_type, title, content, is_read, related_house_id, create_time) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{read}, #{relatedHouseId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId}
UPDATE message SET is_read = TRUE WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message WHERE id = #{id} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_profile WHERE role = 'admin'

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, u.username AS author_name, a.is_active AS active, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM announcement a JOIN user_profile p ON p.id = a.author_id JOIN auth_user u ON u.id = p.user_id ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, u.username AS author_name, a.is_active AS active, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM announcement a JOIN user_profile p ON p.id = a.author_id JOIN auth_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement (title, content, author_id, is_active, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{active}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_active = #{active}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM announcement WHERE id IN #{id}
